class.name: AudioBusSettings
class.brief_description: The stored volume, mute and solo values of one audio bus.
class.description: One entry of [AudioBusListSettings], the settings resource of [AudioBusSettingsServer]. The bus is identified by [member bus_name]. In the settings file, each entry is one [AudioBusSettingsRow] with the values that the project stores ([code]settings/audio_bus/store_*[/code]); the other values of an entry are the values of the bus layout. Change the values through [AudioBusSettingsServer] (for example [method AudioBusSettingsServer.set_bus_volume_db]) or [method ListSettingsServer.set_entry_value], not on the entries of [method SettingsServer.get_settings] directly, so that the change is applied and saved.

method.name: get_volume_linear
method.description: Returns [member volume_db] as a linear value: [code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB, [code]0.0[/code] is -80 dB (silence).

method.name: set_volume_linear
method.description: Sets [member volume_db] from a linear value. [code]0.0[/code] or less is -80 dB. Not a stored property: only [member volume_db] is saved.

members.member: The name of the bus in the bus layout of [AudioServer], for example [code]"Master"[/code] or [code]"Music"[/code].
If [code]true[/code], the bus is muted (see [method AudioServer.set_bus_mute]).
If [code]true[/code], the bus is in solo mode (see [method AudioServer.set_bus_solo]).
The volume of the bus in decibels (see [method AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db]). Clamped to -80 dB … 24 dB, also when a hand-edited file is loaded.
